app.tagline: Arche — your local web, no internet required.
reason.ai_tier: AI model suited to your machine (tier {arg})
reason.replaced_by: Replaced by “{arg}” (more complete, there was room)
warn.over_budget: Selection exceeds the disk budget by {arg} GB. Uncheck items or plug in a bigger disk.
warn.offline: You are offline: only resources already present in an Arche bundle (USB drive) can be installed.
warn.unverified_sizes: Some sizes are estimates: the real total may vary by ±20%.
warn.no_ai_tier: Not enough memory for a local AI model (4 GB minimum).
wizard.welcome: Welcome to Arche. A few questions and we'll prepare your offline library.
wizard.q.library: Which folder? (an external drive is ideal)
wizard.q.bundles: Which topics do you absolutely want? (the rest is chosen for you)
wizard.summary: Selection: {count} items, {size} GB of {budget} GB available.
wizard.detected: Detected machine: {os}/{arch}, {ram} GB RAM, {vram} GB GPU, {disk} GB free.
wizard.done: Done. Run “arche serve” then open http://localhost:8765 in your browser.
dl.verify_fail: Integrity FAILED: {name} — file deleted, run again
cat.freshness: Catalog freshness: {pct}% — {fresh}/{n} resources verified within their interval ({stale} stale, {never} never checked).
cat.freshness_more: … {n} stale or never-checked resources: `--stale` for the full list.
cat.freshness_below: Freshness {pct}% is below the {min}% threshold: the update pipeline is not running or is failing. See docs/en/FRESHNESS.md.
serve.missing: service missing: {name} — install the matching resource (kiwix-tools, ollama, gitea)
serve.no_zim: no ZIM installed: kiwix-serve not started
service.unsupported: Platform not supported by `arche service` (Linux systemd and macOS launchd only). On Windows: Task Scheduler → 'at startup' → `arche serve --quiet`.
service.enable_hint: To enable it now: {cmd}   (or rerun with --enable)
mirror.summary: {n} packages for {roots} roots, {gb} GB ({arch}) — what an offline install needs, and nothing more.
mirror.bloat: ⚠ the recipe estimated ~{est} GB, the closure is {gb} GB: a root pulls too much (meta-package? Recommends?)
mirror.unresolved: {n} dependency(ies) not found in these components/architectures: the mirror will be incomplete for them.
mirror.urls_written: Download list written: {file} ({n} URLs) — `wget -i` or `arche download` can consume it.
visuals.coverage: Visual coverage: {pct}% — {covered}/{required} required views covered by a verified file, across {concepts} concept(s).
reason.not_built: Not built by Arche yet (waiting for the first zim-build run)
reason.explicit_slow: Explicitly requested — exceeds this machine's RAM: will run slowly from disk (see `arche compute estimate`)
